Messages.Author: Algustas
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone,
O.K., it looks like we are ready to start an on-line game. We
currently have four players, we could have another player or two if they
still want to get in.
We will be playing here on the newsgroup, I posted twice to ask
if anyone objected to this, and recieved no negative responses so I
assume you don't mind. The Subject: of the messages will be "Jyhad
on-line" so it will be easy to skip if you are not interested.
We intend to use the Jyhad rules as they stand at the moment, and
I have asked James McClure and Scott Johnson to keep us honest.
Since the on-line format isn't exactly ideal for a card game, we
have decided on a few simple rules to keep things in order:
1) At the start of a players turn, that player will make
a comprehensive posting of his condition: ie. I have Anvil ready with two
blood and a flack jacket, Normal is in torpor paralyzed with one blood,
there is 8 in my pool and I have two on short term investment.

2) When a player declares an action for a minion, she
must wait until her prey & predator post that they are not blocking, or
24 hours have gone by since the post, then may continue with the action.
Weekends are sacred, the 24 hour clock stops at midnight Friday and
starts again at midnight Sunday. Play can continue over the weekend if
people respond: ie. I'm not blocking.

3) Votes will work like blocks, the vote passes or fails
after 24 hours without any more being cast, or when all players say they
are not casting any more votes.

Our current list of players includes:
Errol Trepanier
James E. Lin
Khain
Algustas

Alright then, lets go until Tuesday for questions / new players,
maximum six players please, then lets have Errol determine a random
seating order, after that is posted, lets have James randomly determine
who starts the game, and lets play some Jyhad.
Algustas
*****We have it in our power to begin the world over again***** Thomas Paine

Messages.Author: Stuart J. Pieloch
Messages.Body:
DISCLAIMER:
I am not in the Game.

However, until recently I was under the impression that the game would require
prey to post - no block
predator to post - no block
action successfgul - modifier - resolution

The only problems here are Eagles sight, Mariel tapping, that sort of thing.
I suggest highly that those unusual occurances be broadcast a little mor than
they normally would.

Such as - I am NOT VOTING in this political action.
I am not usual Mariel for any of (insert meth/vamp name here)'s combats
I will not block anything out of turn, until I feel like revoking
this statement.

This leads to interesting tactics of bluffing such as notifying all players to
inform me of all actions in case I want to block, even out of turn.
So do I have an Eagle's sight or not? hmm do you want to bet on it.

Players may feel that they are sacrificing som e of their rights, however,
speed will be neccessary in order to keep the game moving. In other words
if I play a S&B deck, I am playing a one dimensional deck.
My prey should never be able to get in a block if I have designed it correctly
(unless he's really intercept driven) so I will cheerfully let everone know
that I am not voting in any Pol Action unless I have the edge and need to burn
it to avoid loss of pool.
I will also not block a damn thing that is at stealth or unless it is against
me.

I would be giving away good information to others, but I would also speed the
game while not affecting how my cards play.

$0.02 used, please depoisit more money.
Stu

Hi Methuselahs,
O.K., I must not have made myself clear on my last posting, we
have an issue to resolve before we start the game.
The issue is how long do we wait for someone to block an action
before we proceed. I have proposed that we wait until predator & prey say
I'm blocking / not blocking or 24 hours, whichever comes first. A couple
of you have suggested that we just post all our actions and see who
blocks what. I really don't like this suggestion, but since two players
asked for it I think we should vote on it. As soon as everyone logs in a
vote we will start the game.
Vote for version A or version B.

version A: pred/prey says no block or block, or 24 hours pass,
then continue.

version B: Post all actions at once and see who blocks what.

I vote for version A.
Algustas
